meta_home_title: Pencils Down: Exam Proctor, a mobile game about supervising exams
meta_home_desc: Supervise exams: watch the room, read the desks, and decide when to act. Build a career across eight schools. No ads, plays offline. Android and iPhone.

hero_kicker: A mobile game about supervising exams
hero_pitch: You are the supervisor. Watch the room, read what's on the desks, and decide whether to warn, confiscate or remove, or let a moment pass. Odd isn't guilty. Build a career across eight schools, from Maple Elementary to the National Examination Centre, earn coins and dress your supervisor. No ads, fully playable without paying, and it plays offline.
hero_art_alt: An empty exam room in the evening: rows of desks with exam papers, a blackboard and a clock.
icon_alt: Pencils Down app icon: students writing at their desks
store_soon_note: Coming soon to Android and iPhone/iPad.
features_title: Every exam is a room full of small decisions
f1_text: A glance to the side, a hand under the desk, a whisper two rows back. You see what a supervisor sees, and you decide what to do about it: warn, confiscate, remove, or let it go.
f1_alt: An exam room seen from the front, desks set out with papers.
f2_text: A dropped pencil is not a cheat sheet. Read what's on the desks and who is in the seats before you act. A wrong call costs you as much as a missed one, and your reputation remembers both.
f2_alt: A folded note on a desk.
f3_text: Start at Maple Elementary and work your way up to the National Examination Centre. Each school brings its own rooms, its own pressure and its own surprises, from a rush-hour car breakdown to a national examination.
f4_text: The Phone Detector finds phones nearby: a lead, not proof. Stock up on supplies before an exam and decide when they are worth using.
f5_text: Earn coins by doing the job well and spend them in the Wardrobe: tops, trousers, shoes, hats, glasses, badges and the crest of every school you have worked at.
f5_alt: Clothes and accessories from the Wardrobe: a blazer, a cardigan, a bucket hat, round glasses, a watch and a gold badge.
f6_text: No ads, no loot boxes, no timers asking you to pay. The whole game is playable for free; optional purchases are coins and looks, and you always know what you get.
schools_caption: From your first exam room to the country's biggest test.
screens_note: In-game screenshots are on their way. Until then, a look at the game's art.
faq_ads_a: No. There are no ads in the game, and it doesn't use an advertising identifier.
faq_free_a: Yes, it's free to play, and you can play the whole game without paying. Optional purchases are looks and coins. Nothing is random: you always know what you get before you pay.
faq_net_q: Does it need an internet connection?
faq_net_a: No, it plays offline. If you allow it, the game sends anonymous play statistics and crash reports; you can turn this off at any time in Settings. See the Privacy Policy.
faq_langs_a: English, Türkçe, Español, Français, 日本語, Português (Brasil) and Русский.
faq_devices_q: Which devices can I play on?
faq_devices_a: Android phones and iPhone and iPad. Both versions are coming soon.
faq_help_q: I need help with a purchase or my data.
faq_help_a: Write to {email}, or see the Support page.
cta_title: Pencils down. Your exam room is waiting.
footer_tagline: A mobile game about supervising exams.
support_lead: Questions, a bug, a purchase that didn't arrive, or a data request: write to us.
support_include: It helps to include your phone model and the game version, shown in Settings › About.
support_restore_1: Item packs are linked to your Google Play or App Store account. After a reinstall or on a new device, open either:
support_restore_2: Coins are not restored this way: they are stored on your device, not in an account. On Android, Google's Auto Backup (if you have it on) can bring the game's data, coins included, back on a new phone.
support_analytics_title: Turn off usage and crash data
support_analytics_1: Go to Settings → Privacy and terms → Usage and crash data and turn it off. This stops all collection at once and clears the analytics data stored on your device. See the Privacy Policy for what is collected.
support_delete_1: To delete data the game has already sent, email {email_link}. The game has no accounts, so its data is identified by an identifier on your device; we will reply with how to find it, then ask Google to delete the data. Uninstalling the game deletes everything stored on the device.
support_refunds_1: Payments are handled by the store, so refunds are requested there, under its refund policy:
support_version_1: The version you have is shown in Settings › About.
